attBesluta.text: Placed 2 on side of hot tub. Perfect height for drinks etc. Looks great! Being metal should hold up in the Chicagoland elements. Can't beat the price either.

Very happy with this piece. It fits perfectly in the space on our balcony. It is sleek and slim and ideal for us given our lack of space. Is perfect as a bar table and the slits allow draining should the rains turn up.
